about_the_game:
Gargoyle Gatling is a co-op beat 'em up, where you play as up to four gargoyles in a 2.5D environment inspired by the visuals of 90s cartoons and games. The gargoyles have landed in a groovy prison after taking a tumble into hell, and soon find themselves surrounded with hellfire and demons if they're not careful, and even worse is they're all extremely hungry! It's up to them to mow down the demons that stand in their path using weapons they obtain by gambling their very lives away, all in order to hunt down the only Waffle Home that operates in hell and claim the last waffle! Who will be the one to best the others and make it out with a full belly?

The four main Gargoyles are:

  • Rocko, the slow but strong leader of the group. He's stoic and an overall well rounded fighter, a good first pick.

  • Charlie, the agile type who utilized quick kicks and powerful aerial attacks. She's known to use her luxurious hair to her advantage.

  • Sid, a tactical type of fella who prefers to keep enemies at a distance using his speed and large leaps, and let his weaponry do the heavy lifting.

  • Gizmit, the weird little fella who just can't keep still. The other Gargoyles see him as a kind of pet, and alongside his fighting spirit Mooshie he delivers the goofiest moves.

Using these four and their abilities, fight your way through a Prison, the Streets, and even a hellish Casino. Remember to use every tool at your disposal, such as grabs, throws, dash attacks, and the various guns you can obtain by gambling with your life and upgrade using the green orbs demons infamously leave behind. These guns range from powerful shotguns to wimpy water blasters, so make sure you find which one suits your fancy.
